detail.longDescription: AI model distillation trains a smaller student model using signals from a larger teacher model. That can reduce memory use, latency and inference cost while preserving much of the teacher’s useful behavior. It is different from quantization, pruning and standard fine-tuning. https:// thenewsink.com/ai-model-distil lation-explained/ # AI # MachineLearning # LLM # ArtificialIntelligence
